title: 😳 Saloni's Short hit two million views... the Shorts RPM nobody quotes #youtube #shorts
title_alts: 📊 Saloni opens the Shorts pool... how view share decides your payout #youtube #shortsrpm
🧾 Saloni budgeted from her view count... the Shorts RPM gap to expect #youtube #rpm
description_hook: A Short can out-reach everything else you post and still pay the least. Here is where Shorts money actually comes from, and how to price a Short before posting.
setting: a home editing desk beside a window

characters.name: Saloni
characters.description: twenty-eight, shoulder-length black hair tied back, grey hooded sweatshirt, a chipped red nail on her editing hand

claims.basis: round illustrative view count for one Short, stated as an example
round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration
arithmetic from the two figures already stated: two million views at ten cents per thousand

claims.claim: Sixty thousand long-form views can match that
claims.basis: round illustrative comparison that follows only from the assumed rates

scenes.narration: Saloni's Short hit two million views. Her payout was tiny.
scenes.caption: सलोनी के शॉर्ट को बीस लाख व्यूज़ मिले। कमाई बहुत कम रही।
scenes.image_brief: A phone propped against a stack of books on a wooden desk, its screen showing a vertical video with a view counter reading two million, a small notebook and pencil beside it, soft morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: Views feel like money. Do they pay like money?
scenes.caption: व्यूज़ पैसे जैसे लगते हैं। पर क्या ये पैसे जैसे चुकाते हैं?
scenes.image_brief: Two stacks of coins of very different heights standing on a plain sheet of paper on a wooden desk, a phone lying flat beside the taller stack, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Long videos carry ads inside them. A Short does not.
scenes.caption: लंबे वीडियो के अंदर विज्ञापन चलते हैं। शॉर्ट में नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a low table playing a horizontal video with a small ad countdown circle in the corner of its screen, beside it a phone in a stand showing a vertical feed with no ad marker, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: By the end you will price a Short before you post it.
scenes.caption: अंत तक आप पोस्ट करने से पहले शॉर्ट की कीमत आँक लेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A printed sheet of view counts on a desk with a pocket calculator resting on top of it, a mug of tea steaming at the edge of the page, bright daylight from the left.

scenes.narration: Ads between Shorts do not belong to your video. They fill one shared pool.
scenes.caption: शॉर्ट्स के बीच के विज्ञापन आपके नहीं। वे एक साझा पूल भरते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Dozens of small paper play-button shapes falling into one large glass jar on a table, coins already visible at the bottom of the jar, cool even light.

scenes.narration: Music licences are paid out first. What remains is split by view share.
scenes.caption: पहले म्यूज़िक लाइसेंस चुकाए जाते हैं। बाकी रकम व्यू शेयर से बँटती है।
scenes.image_brief: A glass jar of coins on a wooden table with one portion of the coins poured out onto a saucer beside it, the remaining coins sorted into several small uneven piles, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: Take those two million views. Assume ten cents per thousand.
scenes.caption: वही बीस लाख व्यूज़ लें। मान लें हज़ार व्यूज़ पर दस सेंट।
scenes.image_brief: A pocket calculator sitting on graph paper with handwritten multiplication above it, a pencil resting across the page, a phone face down nearby, soft desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Two hundred dollars. Sixty thousand long-form views can match that.
scenes.caption: दो सौ डॉलर। साठ हज़ार लंबे व्यूज़ इतना दे सकते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two open envelopes lying on a desk holding identical small bundles of banknotes, one envelope resting on a phone and the other on a laptop keyboard, plain daylight.

scenes.narration: This is not an argument against Shorts. They find new viewers cheaply.
scenes.caption: यह शॉर्ट्स के ख़िलाफ़ दलील नहीं। वे सस्ते में नए दर्शक लाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a windowsill playing a vertical video, a paper map spread flat underneath it with several coloured pins pushed into different cities, late afternoon light.

scenes.narration: The mistake is budgeting from a view count. Shorts rates keep moving.
scenes.caption: ग़लती है व्यू गिनकर बजट बनाना। शॉर्ट्स की दरें बदलती रहती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A handwritten budget page clipped to a clipboard with a column of view numbers crossed out in red ink, a calculator lying beside it, hard overhead light.

scenes.narration: Views are attention. Revenue comes from the pool, and pools have rules.
scenes.caption: व्यूज़ ध्यान हैं। कमाई पूल से आती है, और पूल के नियम होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A glass jar of coins on a desk with a thin printed rulebook propped open against one side and a phone showing a rising line graph leaning on the other, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: So a small long-form audience can out-earn a viral Short. Comfortably.
scenes.caption: तो लंबे वीडियो का छोटा दर्शक वर्ग वायरल शॉर्ट से ज़्यादा कमा सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small balance scale on a wooden desk, the left pan holding a tall stack of coins next to a laptop, the right pan holding two coins next to a phone, soft window light.

scenes.narration: Open your analytics. Compare RPM on Shorts against your long videos.
scenes.caption: अपना एनालिटिक्स खोलें। शॉर्ट्स और लंबे वीडियो का आरपीएम मिलाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop open on a kitchen table showing an analytics dashboard with two separate revenue lines, a notepad beside it with a pen laid across a blank page, morning light.

title: 😬 Chirag uploaded ninety videos... the reused content rule to know #youtube #monetisation
title_alts: 🤖 Chirag's robot voice reads stock clips... is that reused content? #youtube #automation
🚫 Chirag added no commentary... the reused content refusal it triggers #youtube #reusedcontent
description_hook: Ninety uploads, one line of refusal. Reviewers are not counting your videos, they are looking for the part only you could have made.
setting: a spare bedroom used as a render station

characters.name: Chirag
characters.description: thirty-one, cropped hair with a receding line, faded black t-shirt, thick-framed glasses pushed up on his forehead

claims.basis: round illustrative upload count for one channel, stated as an example

claims.claim: the same ten facts about deep sea fish
claims.basis: illustrative example invented for the comparison, not a measured figure
restates the illustrative upload count already introduced

scenes.narration: Chirag uploaded ninety videos. Monetisation was refused in one line.
scenes.caption: चिराग ने नब्बे वीडियो डाले। कमाई की मंज़ूरी एक लाइन में रद्द हुई।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk showing a grid of ninety identical video thumbnails, beside it a printed sheet carrying a single short paragraph of refusal text, cold blue light from the screen.

scenes.narration: His pipeline was clean. A script, a robot voice, stock clips.
scenes.caption: उसकी पाइपलाइन साफ़ थी। एक स्क्रिप्ट, एक रोबोट आवाज़, स्टॉक क्लिप।
scenes.image_brief: Three things laid out in a row on a desk: a printed script page, a small desktop microphone, and a tablet showing a grid of stock footage clips, even overhead light.

scenes.narration: Nothing was stolen here. Every clip was licensed. Review still failed.
scenes.caption: कुछ चुराया नहीं था। हर क्लिप लाइसेंस वाली थी। फिर भी रिव्यू फेल हुआ।
scenes.image_brief: A stack of licence receipts held down by a smooth grey stone on a wooden desk, a laptop behind them showing a rejected application panel, plain daylight.

scenes.narration: You will learn what a reviewer counts as your own work.
scenes.caption: आप जानेंगे कि रिव्यूअर किसे आपका ख़ुद का काम मानते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An open notebook on a desk with a hand-drawn line dividing the page into two columns, a pen resting in the gutter, a dimmed laptop behind it, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: A reviewer asks one question. What did you add that was not already there?
scenes.caption: रिव्यूअर एक ही सवाल पूछता है। आपने ऐसा क्या जोड़ा जो पहले नहीं था?
scenes.image_brief: A magnifying glass lying on top of a printed video transcript on a desk, one sentence underlined in ink, the rest of the page untouched, soft directional light.

scenes.narration: Stock footage plus a voice that only reads facts adds nothing visible.
scenes.caption: स्टॉक फ़ुटेज और सिर्फ़ तथ्य पढ़ने वाली आवाज़ कुछ नया नहीं जोड़ती।
scenes.image_brief: Two clear glass sheets stacked on a desk over a printed page of plain text, the text fully readable through both sheets, flat even light.

scenes.narration: Two channels post the same ten facts about deep sea fish.
scenes.caption: दो चैनल गहरे समुद्र की मछलियों पर वही दस तथ्य पोस्ट करते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two tablets standing side by side on a dark table, both showing near-identical thumbnails of a glowing deep sea fish, a printed list of ten numbered lines between them, dim blue light.

scenes.narration: One adds its own commentary and edit. One reads the list aloud.
scenes.caption: एक अपनी राय और एडिट जोड़ता है। दूसरा सूची पढ़ देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed list of ten lines on a desk covered with handwritten notes and arrows in the margins, beside a second clean copy of the same list with no marks, warm desk light.

scenes.narration: Automation itself is allowed. Scheduling, templates and voice tools are fine.
scenes.caption: ऑटोमेशन ख़ुद मना नहीं है। शेड्यूलिंग, टेम्पलेट और वॉइस टूल ठीक हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A wall calendar propped on a desk with small coloured stickers marking upload days, a tablet beside it showing a template layout, bright morning light.

scenes.narration: The line is originality, not effort. Ninety fast videos change nothing.
scenes.caption: सीमा मौलिकता है, मेहनत नहीं। नब्बे तेज़ वीडियो कुछ नहीं बदलते।
scenes.image_brief: A long row of identical grey folders standing on a shelf with one folder pulled slightly forward and marked with a single red dot, dim storage room light.

scenes.narration: So the fix is not more uploads. It is more of you.
scenes.caption: तो हल ज़्यादा अपलोड नहीं है। हल है आपका ख़ुद का हिस्सा।
scenes.image_brief: A single video thumbnail printed large and pinned to a corkboard, surrounded by many much smaller printed thumbnails pinned in tight rows, warm side light.

scenes.narration: Pick your weakest video. Add one thing only you could say.
scenes.caption: अपना सबसे कमज़ोर वीडियो चुनें। एक बात जोड़ें जो सिर्फ़ आप कह सकें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop open on a kitchen table showing a video timeline with an empty gap near its start, a handwritten sticky note stuck to the screen bezel, late evening lamp light.

title: 😰 Nitya deleted forty old videos... the watch hours counter she reset #youtube #watchhours
title_alts: ⏳ Nitya tidies her channel early... how watch hours are really counted #youtube #monetisation
🧹 Nitya unlisted her weak uploads... the watch hours mistake to avoid #youtube #watchtime
description_hook: Watch hours are not a savings account. They are recounted from what is public right now, which is why a tidy-up can undo months of work.
setting: a small desk under a shelf of notebooks

characters.name: Nitya
characters.description: twenty-four, long wavy hair with a centre part, olive green cardigan, a thin silver ring worn on her thumb

claims.basis: the published watch hour requirement for joining the partner programme, stable but set by the platform and subject to change
the published rolling window the watch hour requirement is measured over
round illustrative number of videos, stated as an example

claims.claim: three thousand eight hundred qualifying hours
claims.basis: round illustrative starting figure, stated as an assumption
round illustrative share of hours held by the deleted videos
arithmetic from the two illustrative figures already stated

scenes.narration: Nitya deleted forty old videos. Her watch hour total fell overnight.
scenes.caption: नित्या ने चालीस पुराने वीडियो हटाए। उसके वॉच आवर्स रातभर में गिर गए।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk showing a channel video list with forty rows greyed out, beside it a printed graph whose line drops steeply, cool morning light.

scenes.narration: The bar is four thousand public watch hours, over the last twelve months.
scenes.caption: शर्त है चार हज़ार पब्लिक वॉच आवर्स, पिछले बारह महीनों में।
scenes.image_brief: A tall glass measuring jug on a kitchen counter filled most of the way with water, one marked line near the top, a wall clock behind it, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Make a video private, and its hours leave that total.
scenes.caption: वीडियो प्राइवेट किया, तो उसके घंटे उस जोड़ से निकल जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A single video thumbnail printed on card lying face down on a desk with a small padlock resting on it, a laptop behind showing a reduced hour figure, dim lamp light.

scenes.narration: You will know which videos to keep until the counter clears.
scenes.caption: आप जानेंगे कि काउंटर पूरा होने तक कौन से वीडियो रखने हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An open notebook listing video titles with ticks and crosses in the margin, a pen resting across the page, a laptop behind showing a playlist, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: Nothing is banked. The counter re-adds your public watch time daily.
scenes.caption: कुछ जमा नहीं होता। काउंटर हर दिन पब्लिक वॉच टाइम फिर जोड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A tall glass jug of water on a counter with a thin stream pouring in from one side and a small drain open at its base, a level line marked on the glass, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Deleted and unlisted videos drop out. The twelve month window also slides forward.
scenes.caption: हटाए और अनलिस्टेड वीडियो गिनती से बाहर। समय-सीमा भी आगे सरकती है।
scenes.image_brief: A paper calendar strip stretched across a desk with the leftmost months torn off and lying loose, a ruler pinned across twelve remaining squares, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: Say Nitya sat at three thousand eight hundred qualifying hours.
scenes.caption: मान लें नित्या के पास तीन हज़ार आठ सौ मान्य घंटे थे।
scenes.image_brief: A calculator on a desk showing three thousand eight hundred, beside it a printed hours report with one row marked in highlighter, soft lamp light.

scenes.narration: Those forty videos held four hundred. She now shows three thousand four hundred.
scenes.caption: उन चालीस वीडियो में चार सौ घंटे थे। अब तीन हज़ार चार सौ।
scenes.image_brief: Two stacked paper cups of water on a desk, the upper cup emptied into a dish and set aside, the lower water level clearly dropped, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: Clumsy early videos still count. Watch hours do not judge quality.
scenes.caption: भद्दे पुराने वीडियो भी गिने जाते हैं। घंटे गुणवत्ता नहीं आँकते।
scenes.image_brief: Three faded video thumbnails printed on paper and pinned in a row on a corkboard, a small stopwatch hanging beside them, warm side light.

scenes.narration: So archive nothing before you qualify. Tidy the channel up afterwards.
scenes.caption: तो मंज़ूरी मिलने तक कुछ न हटाएँ। सफ़ाई बाद में करें।
scenes.image_brief: A cardboard archive box on the floor with its lid taped shut and a sticky note on top, a laptop on the desk above showing a progress bar, evening lamp light.

scenes.narration: Open your oldest playlist. Is anything unlisted that still earns hours?
scenes.caption: अपनी सबसे पुरानी प्लेलिस्ट खोलें। कोई अनलिस्टेड वीडियो घंटे दे रहा है?
scenes.image_brief: A laptop open on a wooden table showing an old playlist of video rows, a phone beside it displaying a watch time figure, bright morning light.

title: 🤨 Parth's CPM says twelve dollars... why his RPM says under four #youtube #rpm
title_alts: 🧮 Parth reads CPM beside RPM... which number is actually his pay #youtube #cpm
😅 Parth quoted his CPM to a brand... the RPM gap it hides #youtube #adrevenue
description_hook: CPM and RPM describe the same video and never agree. One is what an advertiser paid, the other is what landed in your account.
setting: a desk covered in printed analytics pages

characters.name: Parth
characters.description: thirty, thick black hair pushed back, faded denim shirt, a pencil tucked behind one ear

claims.basis: round illustrative CPM used for the worked example, not a market figure
the creator share of ad revenue on long-form video is a little over half, a published split set by the platform
round illustrative view count, stated as an assumption
round illustrative share of monetised playbacks, stated as an assumption
arithmetic from the stated figures: sixty thousand impressions at twelve dollars per thousand
arithmetic: half of the seven hundred twenty already stated
arithmetic: three hundred sixty dollars spread across a hundred thousand views

scenes.narration: Parth's CPM says twelve dollars. His RPM says under four.
scenes.caption: पार्थ का सीपीएम बारह डॉलर कहता है। आरपीएम चार से कम।
scenes.image_brief: Two printed report cards standing on a desk, one showing a large money figure and one a much smaller figure, a pen lying between them, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: Advertisers bid a CPM. That means cost per thousand ad impressions.
scenes.caption: विज्ञापनदाता सीपीएम पर बोली लगाते हैं। यानी हज़ार इंप्रेशन की कीमत।
scenes.image_brief: A small auction gavel resting on a desk beside a stack of numbered bid cards and a printed grid of empty ad slots, hard overhead light.

scenes.narration: You keep a share of that bid. Only some views show ads.
scenes.caption: उस बोली का एक हिस्सा आपका। हर व्यू पर विज्ञापन नहीं चलता।
scenes.image_brief: A round paper chart on a desk with one wedge cut free and pushed aside, a phone showing a paused video player beside it, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: You will read both numbers without guessing at your income.
scenes.caption: आप दोनों आँकड़े पढ़ लेंगे, कमाई का अंदाज़ा लगाए बिना।
scenes.image_brief: An open notebook on a desk divided into two hand-drawn columns, a calculator resting on the right page, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: CPM counts ad impressions only. RPM counts every view you received.
scenes.caption: सीपीएम सिर्फ़ विज्ञापन इंप्रेशन गिनता है। आरपीएम हर व्यू गिनता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two tally sheets side by side on a desk, the left with far fewer ink marks than the right, a pencil resting between them, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Your cut is roughly half the CPM. Views without ads dilute the average.
scenes.caption: आपका हिस्सा सीपीएम का लगभग आधा है। बिना विज्ञापन वाले व्यू औसत घटाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A tall glass of dark juice on a counter next to a jug of water, some water already poured in and the colour visibly lighter, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Take a hundred thousand views. Say sixty thousand carried ads.
scenes.caption: एक लाख व्यूज़ लें। मान लें साठ हज़ार पर विज्ञापन चला।
scenes.image_brief: A printed analytics table on a desk with a large total row and a smaller marked row beneath it, a highlighter pen alongside, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: Sixty thousand impressions at twelve dollars is seven hundred twenty dollars.
scenes.caption: साठ हज़ार इंप्रेशन, बारह डॉलर पर, यानी सात सौ बीस डॉलर।
scenes.image_brief: A pocket calculator on graph paper with handwritten multiplication above it and coins scattered at the page corner, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Your half is three hundred sixty. Across all views, under four.
scenes.caption: आपका आधा तीन सौ साठ। सारे व्यूज़ पर बाँटें: चार से कम।
scenes.image_brief: A small stack of banknotes on a desk divided into two equal piles by a ruler, one pile pushed away to the edge, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: CPM is not a ceiling either. Your niche and viewer country move it.
scenes.caption: सीपीएम कोई सीमा भी नहीं। आपका विषय और दर्शक का देश इसे बदलते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A world map spread flat on a table with coins of different sizes resting on several countries, a printed list of topics beside it, morning light.

scenes.narration: Comparing your RPM with another channel's is the usual trap.
scenes.caption: अपना आरपीएम दूसरे चैनल से मिलाना आम ग़लती है।
scenes.image_brief: Two printed dashboards clipped side by side to a board, their revenue figures circled in different coloured inks, harsh overhead light.

scenes.narration: So RPM is the honest number. CPM only prices the ad slot.
scenes.caption: तो आरपीएम ईमानदार आँकड़ा है। सीपीएम सिर्फ़ विज्ञापन स्लॉट की कीमत है।
scenes.image_brief: One printed report card standing upright on a desk beside a flat paper ad banner with a small price tag tied to it, soft window light.

scenes.narration: Open the revenue tab. Write down your RPM, not your CPM.
scenes.caption: रेवेन्यू टैब खोलें। अपना आरपीएम लिखें, सीपीएम नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop open on a kitchen table showing a revenue tab, a notepad beside it with one figure written and underlined, morning light.

title: 😵 Mehul's best video earns nothing... the copyright claim in his intro #youtube #copyrightclaim
title_alts: 🎵 Mehul's intro music carries a claim... where his ad money goes #youtube #contentid
🧩 Mehul reused one template track... the copyright claim it repeats #youtube #automation
description_hook: A claim does not delete your video. It quietly redirects the earnings, and one reused template can do it to every upload at once.
setting: a desk stacked with printed timelines

characters.name: Mehul
characters.description: twenty-six, short curly hair, loose grey sweatshirt with a frayed cuff, a thin scar across his left eyebrow

claims.basis: round illustrative number of videos built from one template, stated as an example
restates the illustrative video count already introduced
restates the illustrative video count already introduced

scenes.narration: Mehul's best video earns nothing. Someone else is being paid.
scenes.caption: मेहुल का सबसे बढ़िया वीडियो कुछ नहीं कमाता। पैसा किसी और को जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk showing a video revenue line flat at zero while its view graph climbs steeply, a mug of cold tea beside it, dim evening light.

scenes.narration: A copyright claim does not remove a video. It reassigns the money.
scenes.caption: कॉपीराइट क्लेम वीडियो हटाता नहीं। वह पैसे का रास्ता बदल देता है।
scenes.image_brief: An envelope of banknotes on a desk with a printed arrow card pointing away from a video thumbnail, a rubber stamp lying beside it, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: Background music inside a template copies itself into every upload.
scenes.caption: टेम्पलेट के अंदर का बैकग्राउंड म्यूज़िक हर अपलोड में चला जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single template file card at the centre of a desk with thin threads running from it to forty small printed thumbnails arranged around it, even light.

scenes.narration: You will find the claim before it drains a month's work.
scenes.caption: आप क्लेम ढूँढ लेंगे, इससे पहले कि महीने की कमाई बह जाए।
scenes.image_brief: A magnifying glass resting on a printed list of video titles with one row circled in red ink, a torn calendar page beside it, bright desk light.

scenes.narration: Rights holders register their audio. Every upload is matched against that library.
scenes.caption: राइट्स होल्डर अपना ऑडियो दर्ज करते हैं। हर अपलोड उससे मिलाया जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A shelf of labelled audio reels with one reel pulled out and resting on a reading table, a printed waveform sheet beside it, soft indoor light.

scenes.narration: When a match sticks, ad revenue routes to the claimant. Quietly.
scenes.caption: मैच टिक गया, तो विज्ञापन की कमाई क्लेम करने वाले को जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Two pipes joined by a small brass valve on a workbench, water running out of the side branch instead of the main one, a coin tray under the branch, cool workshop light.

scenes.narration: One stray track sat in Mehul's intro. Forty videos used it.
scenes.caption: मेहुल के इंट्रो में एक ट्रैक रह गया। चालीस वीडियो ने वही चलाया।
scenes.image_brief: An editing timeline printed on paper with one small audio block at its start marked in yellow, a stack of forty identical printed timelines behind it, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Forty claims, one cause. Each old video needs that segment replaced.
scenes.caption: चालीस क्लेम, एक वजह। हर पुराने वीडियो का वह हिस्सा बदलना होगा।
scenes.image_brief: Forty small identical printed notices fanned across a desk with a single audio file card pinned above them, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: A claim is not a strike. Nothing is removed, nothing is warned.
scenes.caption: क्लेम स्ट्राइक नहीं है। वीडियो हटता नहीं, चेतावनी भी नहीं मिलती।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden desk holding a paper notice with a plain unmarked border beside an untouched video thumbnail, no stamps or ink on either, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: But muting a segment can cost retention. Check the affected minutes first.
scenes.caption: पर हिस्सा म्यूट करने से रिटेंशन गिर सकता है। पहले वे मिनट देखें।
scenes.image_brief: A printed retention graph on a desk with a dip marked at its opening seconds and a muted speaker icon card resting on the dip, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: So audit the template, not the videos. One file caused forty problems.
scenes.caption: तो वीडियो नहीं, टेम्पलेट जाँचें। एक फ़ाइल ने चालीस दिक्कतें बनाईं।
scenes.image_brief: A single template file card lying alone on a clean desk under a lamp, forty small thumbnails swept into a neat stack at the desk edge, warm pool of light.

scenes.narration: Open the copyright tab. Sort by views and read the top row.
scenes.caption: कॉपीराइट टैब खोलें। व्यूज़ से सॉर्ट करें और पहली पंक्ति पढ़ें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop open on a kitchen table showing a copyright tab list sorted into rows, a pen resting on a notepad beside it, morning light.

title: 🤑 Trisha's one sponsor beat a month of ads... how that rate is set #youtube #sponsorship
title_alts: 🤝 Trisha prices her first sponsorship... the rate per thousand to quote #youtube #brandeals
😯 Trisha skipped the paid promotion box... what that costs a channel #youtube #disclosure
description_hook: Ad revenue is paid for views you already earned. A sponsor pays for views you have not made yet, which is why the two numbers never match.
setting: a kitchen table used for planning

characters.name: Trisha
characters.description: twenty-nine, dark hair in a low bun, mustard cotton kurta, a small ink stain on her right sleeve

claims.basis: round illustrative forecast used for the example, stated as an assumption
round illustrative sponsor rate, stated as an assumption and not a market quote
arithmetic from the two illustrative figures already stated
round illustrative audience size used to make the comparison concrete

scenes.narration: One sponsor paid Trisha more than a month of ads.
scenes.caption: एक स्पॉन्सर ने त्रिशा को महीने भर के विज्ञापनों से ज़्यादा दिया।
scenes.image_brief: A desk holding a single sealed envelope on the left and a scattered pile of small coins on the right, the envelope noticeably thicker, warm morning light.

scenes.narration: Ad revenue follows views. A sponsor pays for a promise instead.
scenes.caption: विज्ञापन की कमाई व्यूज़ पर चलती है। स्पॉन्सर वादे के लिए देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed contract on a desk beside a rising view graph printout, a pen laid across the contract, even daylight.

scenes.narration: The fee is agreed before the video exists. Views cannot change it.
scenes.caption: रकम वीडियो बनने से पहले तय होती है। व्यूज़ उसे बदल नहीं सकते।
scenes.image_brief: A signed agreement page on a desk with an empty printed thumbnail frame beside it, both held down by a glass paperweight, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: By the end you will price a sponsorship without underselling yourself.
scenes.caption: अंत तक आप स्पॉन्सरशिप की कीमत कम नहीं आँकेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A notepad on a desk with a price figure written and crossed out twice, a calculator resting beside it, bright window light.

scenes.narration: Brands start from your expected views. They quote a rate per thousand.
scenes.caption: ब्रांड आपके अनुमानित व्यूज़ से शुरू करते हैं। फिर हज़ार व्यू की दर देते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A printed forecast chart on a desk with a rate card clipped to its corner, a pencil resting on the rate column, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: That rate follows who watches, not how many. Buyers pay for fit.
scenes.caption: दर इस पर है कि कौन देखता है, कितने नहीं। मेल की कीमत मिलती है।
scenes.image_brief: A desk with two audience profile card stacks side by side, one thick stack of identical cards and one thin stack of detailed ones, a coin resting on the thin stack, warm light.

scenes.narration: Say twenty thousand expected views, at fifteen dollars per thousand.
scenes.caption: मान लें बीस हज़ार अनुमानित व्यूज़, हज़ार पर पंद्रह डॉलर।
scenes.image_brief: A pocket calculator on graph paper with handwritten figures above it and a rate card propped behind, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Three hundred dollars, agreed upfront. The same views earn less from ads.
scenes.caption: तीन सौ डॉलर, पहले से तय। उतने ही व्यूज़ विज्ञापन से कम देते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two envelopes on a desk, one plump and sealed, the other open and holding only a few coins, plain daylight.

scenes.narration: One step is not optional. Tick the paid promotion box, every time. Undisclosed ads break the rules.
scenes.caption: एक बात ज़रूरी है। पेड प्रोमोशन का बॉक्स हर बार टिक करें। छिपा विज्ञापन नियम तोड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk showing an upload settings panel with one checkbox ticked, a printed disclosure note taped beside the screen, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: So audience fit beats raw reach. Ten thousand right viewers can sell more.
scenes.caption: तो दर्शकों का मेल ज़्यादा व्यूज़ से बेहतर है। दस हज़ार सही दर्शक काफ़ी हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A small jar holding a few neatly fitting items beside a wide tray of loose mismatched pieces on a desk, a coin resting inside the jar, morning light.

scenes.narration: List your last three videos. Which brand belonged in each one?
scenes.caption: अपने पिछले तीन वीडियो लिखें। हर एक में कौन सा ब्रांड फिट होता?
scenes.image_brief: Three printed video thumbnails laid in a row on a table with a blank sticky note placed on each, a pen beside them, bright daylight.
